summary.text: Ricardo Cabrera, a Republican San Diego small business owner and cybersecurity professional, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in California's 51st District to Sara Jacobs.
He had not previously held elected office.
In his Ballotpedia survey he said he ran on congressional term limits, affordability and fiscal responsibility.

paragraphs.text: Cabrera describes himself as a San Diegan, small business owner and cybersecurity professional. Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from Grand Canyon University (2024) and a graduate degree from the same university (2026), and lists chief executive officer as his career experience.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary with 37.0% of the vote, behind Jacobs (57.7%).
He received 36.0% of the vote to Sara Jacobs's 64.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
